_comment: Relevance Ranker (§18.3) persona-specific DEFAULT weights. Data only — edit these values to retune personas WITHOUT touching application logic. Each persona needs all nine weights w1..w9; w8 (noise_prior) and w9 (recent_volume) are applied as SUBTRACTIVE by the scorer, so store them as positive magnitudes. Feature order: w1 materiality, w2 position_weight, w3 thesis_linkage, w4 rule_linkage, w5 strategy_linkage, w6 novelty, w7 actionability, w8 noise_prior, w9 recent_volume.
